### Workflow entry: urlshort-slice-delegated-b@1 step requirements

Entry step: requirements (requirements)

Root objective: Slice 02-brownfield/06-client-identity (OPR.99.0.3.6), human decision D21 (qitem-20261004003331-0b5245ad): a behaviour-preserving refactor so ONE component answers 'who is this client' (docs/guidance/architecture.md section 11, register row 1). New web/ClientIdentity owns the trusted-proxy rule (today RateLimitFilter.clientOf, ADR-0015), the resolved-client request attribute (today RateLimitFilter.CLIENT_ATTRIBUTE, read by ClickRecorder) and the audit guard's predicate (direct loopback peer, no X-Forwarded-For or Forwarded header, no remote-IP rewriting configured; today AuditController.fromLoopback and peerIsConnection, ADR-0019 and 01-audit-read's CR-01 fix). RateLimitFilter, ClickRecorder and AuditController call it. ADR-0015 is amended to name it the one code path. Behaviour unchanged: no new behaviour, setting, endpoint or dependency. Proof per docs/guidance/brownfield.md section 6 (refactors): characterization tests FIRST pinning today's exact answers across peer, X-Forwarded-For and Forwarded headers, trusted-proxy lists, loopback or not, and both server.tomcat.remoteip header settings; the move in its own commits, separate from test changes; every existing journey passes unchanged (AuditForwardedHeadersJourneyTest, AuditAccessSettingsJourneyTest, RateLimit and TrustedProxy journeys, StatsV2JourneyTest, TrustedProxyClickJourneyTest); 100 % coverage; openapi.json regenerates identical; QA compares live responses and log lines before and after. Territory and the unit-test rule are in missions/02-brownfield/slices/06-client-identity/slice.yaml. Brownfield: design writes impact-analysis.md before design.md. Worktree .worktrees/06-client-identity on slice/06-client-identity from main 5cfdf8a. Plan-lock is the lead's (D11). Lane B: design2-agent, dev2-agent, qa2-agent (proof judge), review2-agent.

Step objective: Write the slice SPEC.md: user stories, GIVEN/WHEN/THEN acceptance criteria, business rules, scope, ambiguity log, proof contract. Park a real ambiguity on the human; otherwise record safe defaults.
